chunks: Even though all the signs came to them, not till they face the grievous punishment.
ai.seo_question: Why did the disbelievers not believe even when shown all the signs?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of *'urf* (habituation) and the hardening of the heart, illustrating that mere intellectual evidence is insufficient without spiritual receptivity. It serves as a precursor to the divine punishment, highlighting that the 'painful punishment' itself becomes the ultimate, albeit reluctant, sign for those who stubbornly reject earlier miracles.
